description: a ghostly caravan merchant from the dunes, a pale translucent old trader in a hooded sand-coloured cloak who casts no shadow, lifting the canvas cover of a wooden cart with no wheels heaped with old swords, jewels and trinkets, a faint blue ghostly glow and wisps of mist around the cart, full body, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, muted sandy colours
